The '''droid gladiatorial arena''' was located at the center of the town of [[Ghaz Kul IV]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pitann]]. It held the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] [[Pitann droid gladiatorial games|contests]] that were popular on the planet in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The arena contained several thousand seat surrounding a dusty, [[Oil/Legends|oil]]-stained floor.

The arena was located next to [[Uta T'Cha's workshop]].
